run_hpatches_metrics: run the main function to compute repeatability and homography estimation metrics for the HPatches dataset
compute_metrics: compute and return all provided metrics as a dictionary of tensor values converted to Python types
visualize_keypoint_matches: visualize keypoint matches between two images with optional good matches mask and dump result as PNG
vizualize_keypoints: visualize keypoints and matched points on an image with green and red markers and save as PNG
visualize: visualize batch elements from a data loader including keypoints, matches, and probability maps
